builder.objective: REPAIR V3-03: Make the cursor stable for equal timestamps: use a composite cursor (occurredAt + id) with a deterministic secondary sort key (e.g., ORDER BY occurredAt DESC, id DESC and cursor predicate (occurredAt < c.occurredAt OR (occurredAt = c.occurredAt AND id < c.id))) in both InMemory and SQLite repositories, and add a test seeding >PAGE_SIZE entries with one identical occurredAt plus older entries, asserting every seeded id is reachable exactly once across pages.; Guard loadHistory against concurrent execution (in-flight ref that skips or queues a second call) or dedupe by entry id in the merge step, and add a test that two concurrent load-more calls do not duplicate entries.; Use the entry's stored unit (e.unit) in the share message and in the history row display instead of the current household unit, so historical entries keep their original unit label.; Block the submit when the custom split sum differs from amountMinor (disable the button or early-return in submitExpense with the inline error), so an invalid custom-split expense can never be persisted.
builder.scope: Repair only the audited must-fix findings on the preserved V3 baseline; do not rebuild accepted work.
